x-eas.doc: A playable maze game: the arrow keys steer the eater through a maze of gums every half second while ghosts chase it (Vega gallery: pacman).

maze.doc: 16 rows of 16 hex digits, one per cell: 1 a wall on its left edge, 2 on its top edge, 4 a gum, 8 a power gum

size.doc: width and height in pixels (15 cells a side)

description.default: A playable pacman game with ghosts and gums.

title.doc: chart title (the gallery example has none)

vega.note: The first frame matches. The arrows steer the eater on a 500 ms timer (x-eas.timer, x-eas.on); gums score 10 and power gums 50; ghosts chase along the longer axis and wander when blocked; a ghost on the eater restarts the game. Ghosts are Vega's own SVG path symbol (size scale null, so sqrt(size)/2 is Vega's unit), the outer walls overhang the 600px view by 2px as in Vega (the canvas grows to 602px) and the black is the view fill, so the padding stays transparent. Not ported: power mode (fleeing, edible ghosts) and Vega's ghost decision tables. Against the vg2png (node-canvas) reference, re-measured in eas-7r1.12d with rsvg-convert and Liberation Sans: ratio 0.0003 (was 0.0115); the rest is the score text's antialiasing.
